en.description:
Important Note: This app can only be downloaded from the App Store on Apple Watch. Here's how:

1. Press the Digital Crown on your watch to open the app list
2. Find and open the App Store
3. Scroll to the bottom and tap "Account"
4. Find "Purchased" to download the app

Animal Merge is a physics-based puzzle game designed exclusively for Apple Watch, bringing you smooth merging gameplay with realistic physics engine right on your wrist!

Key Features

Watch Optimized Design

- Perfectly sized for Watch screen
- Optimized touch controls
- Smooth gameplay animations
- Realistic physics engine

Easy to Play

- Drag and drop animals
- Matching animals merge automatically
- Unlock higher-level creatures
- Evolve from parrots to elephants

Casual Challenge

- Beat your high score
- Strategic placement
- Test your reflexes and planning
- Auto-save progress

Game Features

- 11 Adorable Animals: Experience complete evolution chain
- Satisfying merge effects: Particle effects and audio feedback
- Haptic feedback: Immersive gaming experience
- Auto-save: Continue anytime

Highlights

- No internet required
- No advertisements
- Completely free
- Standalone - no iPhone needed

Challenge yourself with this Watch-exclusive physics puzzle!

Requirements

Requires watchOS 9.0 or later
en.subtitle: Mini animal puzzle

zh.description:
重要提示：此游戏只能在 Apple Watch 上的玩耍：

如果已经下载可以：
1. 按下数码表冠打开应用列表
2. 找到并打开 App Store
3. 滚动到底部点击"账户"
4. 找到"已购项目"下载应用

动物合成是一款专为 Apple Watch 设计的物理合成益智游戏，在你的手腕上体验真实物理引擎带来的流畅合成乐趣！

核心特色

手表专属优化

- 完美适配手表屏幕
- 优化的触控操作
- 流畅的游戏动画
- 真实物理引擎

简单易玩

- 拖动投放动物
- 相同动物自动合成
- 解锁更高级形态
- 从鹦鹉进化到大象

休闲挑战

- 挑战最高分记录
- 策略性放置
- 考验反应和规划
- 随时保存进度

游戏特色

- 11种可爱动物：体验完整的进化链条
- 华丽合成特效：粒子效果和音效反馈
- 触感反馈：沉浸式游戏体验
- 自动存档：随时继续游戏

游戏亮点

- 无需网络连接
- 完全没有广告
- 完全免费
- 独立运行无需iPhone

在手表上体验专属的物理合成益智挑战！

系统要求

需要 watchOS 9.0 或更高版本
